docs.title: Line Stoppages Tracking Module User Guide
docs.text: Date: 22-09-2025 Contact: support@factri.ai

docs.title: 1. Introduction
docs.text: This document outlines the guidelines for using the DataWiz application in the Bangalore and Chennai plants for the Line Stoppage Trackings.

docs.title: 2. Installation and Login
docs.text: The application URL is https://satrac-line-tracker.datawiz.app/login. Chrome is the recommended browser.

docs.title: Mobile App Installation
docs.text: Using the mobile app is recommended for making work order confirmations. 1. Open the application URL in your mobile browser. 2. Click on the settings button from the top right corner. 3. Click on the ‘Add to Home Screen’ button. 4. Select the ‘Install’ option. 5. Login using the credentials provided by the DataWiz team.

docs.title: 3. Scan the Line QR Code
docs.text:
The Line QR Codes will be provided by the DataWiz team

  1. Login to the app on a Mobile device.
  2. At the landing page, you will see a SCAN QR/BARCODE button. Click on it to scan the respective line QR code. Alternatively, you can also select the respective line from the dropdown provided below.
  3. You will be taken to the Lines page, where all the stoppages, active and resolved, will be accessiable.

docs.title: a. Report a Stoppage
docs.text:
1. At the Lines page, press the Report a Stoppage button from the top section.
  2. After clicking on the button, you will taken to the stoppage reporting form. Here you can enter all the stoppage instance related information.
    • Select if the stoppage is Blocking or Non-Blocking in nature.
    • Select the reason category and code most relevant for this instance of stoppage from the dropdown.
    • Update the start time of the stoppage if required.
    • Enter the SF number this instance of stoppage is having effect on. You can scan the SF number QR code as well to auto fill the number directly.
    • Enter the notes for your side adding more context to the stoppage reporting such that your team member is informed correctly.
  3. After entering all the stoppage related details, press the Report Stoppage button.
  4. This will report the stoppage, and the escalation email chain will be triggere. Please refer the notification section for more details.

docs.title: b. Discuss Over the Stoppage Issue
docs.text:
1. Your team can dicuss over the specific issue directly at the stoppage details page itsel.
  2. Click on the Message tab from the top section. It will open a chat window, where team members can send their messages, tag the relevant users.
  3. Real-time notifications will be sent to the tagged users.

docs.title: c. Resolve a Stoppage
docs.text:
1. At the Lines page, select the stoppage that needs to be resolved.
  2. Click on the Resolve Stoppage button. Enter the resolution related notes and change the resolution time i.e End Time if required.
  3. Click on the Resolve button.
  4. This will report the stoppage resolution and the resolution related mail will be sent to all the relevant groups.

docs.title: 4. Access Past Stoppages
docs.text:
1. For reference or analysis to access all the past stoppages click on View All Stoppages button from the bottom of the landing page.
  2. Based on the plant assess, the user will see all the past stoppages.
  3. Use the provided filter options to look for the stoppages required for analysis.

docs.title: Production Tracking Module User Guide
docs.text: Date: 22-09-2025 Contact: support@factri.ai

docs.title: 1. Introduction
docs.text: This document outlines the guidelines for using the DataWiz application in the Bangalore and Chennai plants for the Production Tracking use case. The application is optimized to improve user experience and data accuracy.

docs.title: Desktop Login
docs.text: The application URL is https://satrac.datawiz.app. Chrome is the recommended browser.

docs.title: Mobile App Installation
docs.text:
Using the mobile app is recommended for making work order confirmations.

  1. Open the application URL in your mobile browser.
  2. Click on the settings button from the top right corner.
  3. Click on the ‘Add to Home Screen’ button.
  4. Select the ‘Install’ option.
  5. Login using the credentials provided by the DataWiz team.

docs.title: 3. Printing Chassis QR Codes
docs.text:
To print QR codes for chassis orders released to the Chennai or Bangalore plants:

  1. Login to the app on a Desktop device.
  2. From the orders table (and FG Orders section) on the landing page, select the checkboxes for the required orders.
  3. Use the filter options or increase the "per page" value to select multiple orders.
  4. Select the ‘Print QR’ option to download a PDF containing the unique chassis QR codes.

docs.title: 4. Scanning and Order Details
docs.text: Scan the printed QR code using the DataWiz mobile app to land directly on the order details page.

docs.title: Features on the Details Page
docs.text:
• KPI Cards: View Total Lead Time, Total WIP Aging, Total Cycle Time, and On-Time Status.
  • Stage Tracking: View cycle time and WIP aging for the current stage.
  • Confirmation Actions: Perform start, stop, pause, or confirm actions on the current stage.
  • All Stages: Press the ‘View All Stages’ button to access all details of the stages defined for the order.
  • Documents: Upload or view existing order documents.

docs.title: 5. Making Confirmations
docs.text:
The following actions can be performed to capture production data:

  • START: Press when starting work at a stage to capture start time for cycle calculations.
    • Available for: Subassembly, SFG, Painting, and Finishing.
  • PAUSE / RESUME: Use these buttons if work needs to be temporarily stopped and restarted.
    • Available for: Subassembly, SFG, Painting, and Finishing.
  • COMPLETE: Press when work is finished to capture completion time and input details like line number and supervisor.

docs.title: Confirmation Logs
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the stages section of a specific work order.
  2. Click the ‘View Logs’ button on the right side for each stage.
  3. Logs are sorted from most recent to oldest.
  4. Click ‘View Details’ to see any further information entered by the user during that action.

docs.title: PPC Dashboard
docs.text: Click the ‘View PPC Dashboard’ button on the landing page. * Production Reports: Monthly, Weekly, Daily, and Line-wise trends for SFG, Painting, and Finishing stages. * WIP Aging Reports: Data by stations and aging buckets, provided in both visual and tabular formats. * Sale Order Tracker: Progress for orders with due dates from the last 31 days to the next 31 days. * Plant Filter: Access Chennai and Bangalore plant data separately or together.

docs.title: Subassembly Tracking Module User Guide
docs.text: Date: 22-09-2025 Contact: support@factri.ai

docs.title: 1. Introduction
docs.text: This document outlines the guidelines for using the DataWiz application in the Bangalore and Chennai plants for the Subassembly Tracking use case.

docs.title: 2. Installation and Login
docs.text:
The application URL is https://satrac.datawiz.app. Chrome is the recommended browser.

For mobile app installation, please refer this section.

docs.title: 3. Printing Chassis QR Codes
docs.text:
To print QR codes for chassis orders released to the Chennai or Bangalore plants:

  1. Login to the app on a Desktop device.
  2. From the orders table select the Subassembly orders section on the landing page, you will see all the subassembly orders auto-generated in the system.
  3. Select the checkboxes for the required orders. Use the filter options or increase the "per page" value to select multiple orders. You can also use the Sale Order column filter option to filter only the required subassembly orders.
  4. Select the ‘Print QR’ option to download a PDF containing the unique chassis QR codes.

docs.title: 4. Scanning and Order Details
docs.text: Scan the printed QR code using the DataWiz mobile app to land directly on the subassembly tracking page.

docs.title: 5. Making Confirmations
docs.text:
The following actions can be performed to capture production data:

  • COMPLETE: Press when work is finished to capture completion time and input details like line number and supervisor.

docs.title: Confirmation Logs
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the stages section of a specific work order.
  2. Click the ‘View Logs’ button on the right side of the stage.
  3. Logs are sorted from most recent to oldest.
  4. Click ‘View Details’ to see any further information entered by the user during that action.

docs.title: Sub Assembly Report
docs.text:
1. Click the ‘View PPC Dashboard’ button on the landing page.
  2. Select the Sub Assembly tab from the top right corner.
    • This report shows the produced subassemblies against the sale orders they were created against.
